author: Inside Edition
description: Balloons are a festive sign you're at a fun party! But after the cake is served and the last dance is danced, they deflate into nothing more than trash, and they can stick around for years in landfills, oceans, or wherever they end up. Now, a group of scientists in the UK have created a more eco-friendly option. They call it the Bioloon, made of a latex that degrades quicker than normal. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Scientists Create Biodegradable Balloons For A More Eco-Friendly Party

author: Inside Edition
description: What was supposed to be a routine check of a rest area in Medina County, turned out to be a bittersweet surprise for one Ohio State Trooper. One trooper discovered an abandoned puppy inside a crate along I-71. In bodycam footage, recorded on August 23, but recently released by Ohio State Highway Patrol, the trooper can be seen removing cardboard from around the crate and then the dog who seemed thrilled to be out of the crammed space.
title: Highway Patrol Officer Rescues Dog Abandoned on Ohio Highway
